item.title: Trump Says Focus Is on Criminals but Backs Broader Deportations
item.description: Reporter: Would you support mass deportations of people who are otherwise law-abiding? TRUMP: We want to see everybody, but we’re focusing on the criminals… Ultimately, yeah, it’s exactly as I said during the campaign.

item.title: Secret Service Arrests Ohio Man Accused of Threatening to Kill Vice President Vance
item.description: The Secret Service arrested a 33-year-old Toledo man on Friday after a federal grand jury indicted him for allegedly threatening to shoot and kiII Vice President JD Vance with an M14 rifle.

item.title: Cooper, Kushner, Witkoff Meet Sailors and Marines Aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: Earlier today, Adm. Brad Cooper, Commander of U.S. Central Command, Jared Kushner, and Steve Witkoff met with sailors and Marines aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln.

item.title: Brooklyn Waterways Freeze as Dangerous Cold Grips New York City
item.description: Waterways in Brooklyn, New York are frozen solid as below freezing temperatures impact the region. New York City is expected to see dangerously cold temperatures throughout the weekend.

item.title: Italian Police Fire Tear Gas as Protesters Clash Near Winter Olympics Hockey Venue
